title: AddToMealPlanSheet: hierarchical list shell
description: Build the new sheet view structure with NavigationStack, loading state, cancel toolbar, create-new-plan row, per-plan sections, block rows, and inline add-new-section rows.
acceptance_criteria: `AddToMealPlanSheet` exists as a single-screen SwiftUI sheet with title `Add to meal plan` and a leading Cancel button.
The list shows a loading placeholder until plan discovery completes, a create-new-plan row at the top, and one section per discovered plan with block rows plus a final add-new-section row.
The empty state shows only the create-new-plan row when no plans exist.
